title: Patch: three attack timings: "When" before, "Whenever" after even if gone, "After" only if still there
thread:
**Issue #2396 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2396: Patch: three attack timings: "When" before, "Whenever" after even if gone, "After" only if still there
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

This is the owner's ruling. It replaces part of #2285's reading, under which "When" and "Whenever this attacks" were one timing ([R2285000]). A card's own attack and kill triggers now have three timings, one word each:

| Word | Resolves | Survival |
|---|---|---|
| **When** this attacks | before any damage of the attack (`whenAttacks`, R2285000) | not asked: it happens before the fight |
| **Whenever** this attacks / this destroys a Unit | after the attack or kill, once its combat's state check has run | **not required**: it resolves even if the card is no longer on the field |
| **After** this attacks / this destroys a Unit | after the attack or kill, once its combat's state check has run (`afterAttack`, R2285001; R1245's kill triggers) | required: only for a card still on the stay it attacked from (R174) |

### Cards

- **Classic #13 Boots on the Ground** (`classic-013`) moves from "After" to **"When"**:
  - Base 2/1: `Charge\nWhen this attacks, draw {draw}.`
  - Radiant 4/2: `Charge\nWhen this attacks, Recruit {recruits|card|cards}.`
  - Its script moves from `after_attack` to `when_attacks`. It draws or Recruits before the damage, and still does when it dies in that combat. This holds for declared and forced attacks (R53, #9 Moths to the Flame). An attack called off in its trap window runs nothing (R44), and defending is not attacking.
- **#32 Prem Panther** (`core-032`) moves from "After" to **"Whenever"**:
  - Base 5/4 and Radiant 10/8 (Rush, Cleave): `Rush\nWhenever this attacks, draw {draw} for each Unit that attack destroyed.` (The Radiant face keeps Cleave in its keyword line.)
  - It draws 2 for each Unit its attack destroyed: the Unit it attacked, plus Radiant's Cleave kills (R42). It draws even when it traded itself away. It draws for the player who controlled it in that combat (R212). It never draws for a kill made while defending. Declared and forced attacks both count.
- **Meditative #95.1 CN Golem** keeps **"Whenever this destroys a Unit"**, and its text is unchanged. Under the new "Whenever" it resolves even if it died in the same combat, replacing [R1245]'s survival clause for it.
  - **CN Golem now shuffles its CN-Virus even when it dies in the combat that killed the Unit.**
  - It still shuffles one per Unit it is R42's killer of, Cleave and Poisonous kills included.
- **Stinkyscape #75 Badger, #76 Honey Badger and Meditative #91.1 Windfurious Prime** print "Whenever this attacks" and resolve before the damage (R2285000, R1203). Prime's joiners "attack its target first", so it must resolve before. Their text changes from "Whenever this attacks" to **"When this attacks"**, and they play exactly as today. This is a wording change only.
  - Badger: `When this attacks, gain a random Stinkyscape Resource.` Radiant: `… a random Radiant Stinkyscape Resource.`
  - Honey Badger: the same.
  - Windfurious Prime: `When this attacks: Summon {joiners|random Unit|random Units} from your hand or deck. They attack its target first.`
- **Classic+ #19.5 Bot Loser and Training Grounds #9 Ravager** change from "Whenever this destroys a Unit" to **"After this destroys a Unit"**. They play exactly as today, since R1245's "dying in the same combat it gains nothing" already holds for them. This is a wording change only.
  - Bot Loser: `After this destroys a Unit, it gains +{attackGain} Attack.` (both faces)
  - Ravager: `After this destroys a Unit, it gains +{buff}/+{buff}.` (both faces)
  - Jungle Loser's (C+ #19.2) Radiant credit still fires Bot Loser's trigger. Update the "whenever this destroys a Unit" in its `spec/08-catalog.md` row.
- **Unchanged**:
  - "After" cards keep requiring survival (R2285001): Stinkyscape #91 The Propagation's Wasp, #92 The Propagation's Hornet and #94 Tmack Trav ("After this destroys a Unit").
  - "When" cards stay as they are: Classic+ #73.1 Classic Golem.
  - Shield Amplifier ("Whenever this survives an attack") asks for survival in its own words.
  - Out of scope: "Whenever this takes damage" and "Whenever this damages a Unit" (#91 Fed Fauci, Meditative #2 Rampaging Rhino, #72 The Banisher). Those answer a damage event, not an attack or a kill, and R212 still governs them.

### Engine

"Whenever this attacks" needs an after-attack hook that skips R2285001's check that the attacker is still on its stay. Pick the simplest form that reads like `combat.rs`'s `afterAttack` path, either a second hook field beside `after_attack` or a flag on the `Script`.
- Read `work.rs`'s header first: the hook must stay parkable (R113).
- It runs at the same point (§4.2 step 5) with the same facts (`afterAttackOf`: `targetId`, `destroyedIds`, `forced`). `survived` is false for a card that died.
- A card that died runs the hook from the snapshot it fought with.

CN Golem's kill trigger ("Whenever this destroys a Unit") likewise drops its check that the killer is still on the field as the `destroyed` is dispatched. It answers the kill for the player who controlled the Golem when it happened (R212). Bot Loser's and Ravager's ("After") keep the check.

Decide in the ruling, by Hearthstone semantics, what a card brought back by Reborn in the same check does. The suggestion: the trigger is owed to the attack or the kill, so it resolves once, never twice.

## Spec and rulings

- `spec/06-keywords.md`:
  - The "When this attacks" row covers "When" only.
  - Add a **Whenever** row: after the attack or kill, survival not required, covering "this attacks" and "this destroys a Unit".
  - The "After" row stays and gains "this destroys a Unit".
- `spec/04-combat.md`: in §4.2 step 4 and step 5 and in the forced-attacks paragraph, place "Whenever" beside "After".
- Add a new ruling for the three timings, numbered from this issue's block (CLAUDE.md rule 3), with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/2396.md`. It amends:
  - R2285000: "Whenever this attacks" is no longer "When".
  - R2285001: drop Panther and Boots.
  - R1245: CN Golem no longer asks for survival.
  - R426: Panther draws on trade.
  - R212: its Panther sentence.
  - R1203, if it cites Prime's "Whenever".
- Keep `proven_in` and the R-ids cited in code consistent, so `cargo jackioh spec check` passes.
- In `spec/08-catalog.md`, `spec/07-tokens.md` and `catalog.json`, update the rows and texts of every card above.
- Update card headers and tests:
  - Boots's, Panther's and CN Golem's test modules (BUILD M4-T4 row 32; M9 Classic row 13).
  - Bot Loser's and Ravager's headers, for the new word.
  - The cross tests that lean on the old timing (`crates/cards/tests/cross/*`, `crates/engine/tests/rules/after_attack.rs`, `when_attacks.rs`).
  - `apps/web/src/tutorial/lessons/*` and `e2e/`, for any of these cards' old text.

## Acceptance

- Base Boots attacks into a Unit that kills it: its player has drawn 1, and the `Drawn` event comes **before** the combat's damage. The same holds for a forced attack (Moths to the Flame). Radiant Boots Recruits before the damage, with a Trap landing face-down (R33). An attack called off in its trap window (My Pawn) runs neither face.
- Base Prem Panther attacks a Unit, kills it and dies in the trade: its controller draws 2.
- A Radiant Panther whose Cleave also kills draws 2 per Unit destroyed, whether or not it survives.
- A Panther that kills nothing draws nothing, and a Panther that kills while defending draws nothing. A forced attack that kills draws.
- A Panther stolen by a Death in the check (#86 "Miss" Mrow) still draws for the player who attacked with it (R212).
- A Panther that trades and comes back through Reborn draws exactly once.
- A CN Golem that kills a Unit and dies in the same combat shuffles its CN-Virus. One that kills two Units with Cleave shuffles two.
- Ravager and Bot Loser gain when they kill and survive. They gain nothing when they die in that combat (their existing tests, under the new "After" text).
- Badger, Honey Badger and Windfurious Prime still resolve before the damage, as their existing tests show, under their new "When" text.
- Stinkyscape #91, #92 and #94 still do nothing after an attack or kill they died in (R2285001).
- The new ruling's proving tests are named after it (`fn r<n>_…`), and `cargo jackioh spec check`, `catalog check` and `patches check` pass.
- A pending fragment claims every card that plays differently, as `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` names them (at least `core-032`, `classic-013` and `meditative-095-1`, with `--plays` where the catalog doesn't change). It carries a player note: `changes` for the play changes, `text` for the wording-only cards.
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` (golden replay included) are green.

## Blocked by, part of

Follows #2285 (R2285000–R2285002).
```

## Decisions
- Engine form: bool flag `after_attack_even_if_died` on `Script` (script.rs after `after_attack`). Rejected: second hook field (every `after_attack.is_some()` reader + two-hook sequencing in `combatant_hooks`).
- `run_after_attack` (combat.rs ≈2426): read script once; `self_card = match (live, survived) { (Some(live), true) => live, _ if even_if_died => owed.snapshot.clone(), _ => return }`; insert `prompts::SELF_KEY` snapshot into data when `!survived` (as pre-#2324 code, `git show 688d84021^:crates/engine/src/combat.rs`).
- Fusion (#99 Craft a Card can fuse Panther): fuse.rs `after_attack_even_if_died: any`, and `after_attack: hooks(after_attack_part, …)` where a non-flagged ingredient's hook is wrapped to return `vec![]` when `after_attack_of(ctx).survived == false`.
- Reborn: survived=false → runs once from snapshot; draws once. Ruling R2396000 says so.
- KEPT_SCRIPTS: newest shipped = v0.5.6b. Add `script_v0_5_6b` to both card files + entries in crates/cards/src/history.rs (contract: crates/cards/README.md §6, ADDING_CARDS §3). #2324 did not keep — note as decision.

- Fixtures (damage_combat.rs): even_veteran 4753, reborn_even_veteran 4754, even_asker 4755, gone_killer 4756, reborn_gone_killer 4757; fns even_noter(), gone_kill_noter().
- Tests: after_attack.rs mod r2396000_whenever_this_attacks (5), new whenever_kills.rs (5) in mod_2.rs. Running.
- RESULT: all 10 new engine tests + existing after_attack/after_attacked pass in scratch (cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' -- r2396000 after_attack).
- Cards changes applied in scratch (Panther/Boots/Golem + history.rs kept v0.5.6b). Running full engine+cards suites next.
- Prime's test r1203_radiant_adds_first_strike_and_keeps_the_rider asserts radiant text -> must update.
- Bot Loser has no die-in-combat test (Ravager has r1245_if_it_dies_in_the_same_combat_it_gains_nothing).
